name: Public procurement of works
review_status: Drawn from public statutory sources. Pending review by a Romanian procurement specialist before it is relied on for a tender.
references: HG 395/2016, norme metodologice de aplicare a Legii 98/2016 (https://legislatie.just.ro/Public/DetaliiDocument/179009)
description: Public works contracts are awarded under Legea 98/2016 and its implementing norms. The client's estimated value rests on the deviz general, and the bidder returns a priced deviz ofertă for each object against the same list of works, so the tender can be compared line by line.
practice_notes: The bill goes out as a list of works per object and comes back priced on the same lines
The contingency in chapter 5.3 of the deviz general belongs to the client's budget, not to the bidder's price
